Thank you for your feedback, and I’m very sorry to hear about your experience. 

After checking the system last night, the blood test request was not showing when the phlebotomist looked for it, which is why they were unable to proceed at the time. The Phlebotomist checks she has all the labels at the start of her clinic, and this is how reception knew the labels were not available.

If your GP Practice added your blood test requests after you contacted them, they should have advised you to come back to the surgery to see if the phlebotomist would be able to see you. 

 I completely understand how frustrating this must have been, especially as you had been waiting, were unwell, and had been fasting. 

It may also help to clarify that although the blood‑taking service is based at our practice, it is run by the Enhanced Hours Team. If you would like to make a formal complaint about the service you received, I can pass this directly to the Enhanced Hours management team so they can review what happened.

Regarding fasting, we would not ask any of our patients to fast until 5pm. We offer morning appointments specifically for fasting blood tests. If you were advised to fast until that time, you will need to contact your own GP practice to discuss this further, as that advice would not have come from us.

Thank you again for taking the time to share your experience — your feedback is important, and we want to ensure this is looked into properly.

If you would like to discuss this further, please contact me on 0161 9985538.

Best regards,
Dan Hey
Practice Manager We’re disappointed to receive a 1‑star review, as we strive to make accessing care as smooth as possible.

 We understand that online booking can be difficult for some patients, which is why we provide several alternatives. You can call our reception team and they will complete the form on your behalf, or you can visit the practice to fill out a paper version. 

We accept appointment requests from 07:30 until 18:30, and all requests are triaged by a GP the same day, with patients receiving a response within 1 working day. Appointments are offered the same day for urgent requests, or within two weeks for non‑urgent requests.

 For some minor illnesses, you may be referred to the pharmacy under the national Pharmacy First scheme. We have worked hard to remove barriers for our patients while improving our appointment system, and we truly value feedback that helps us continue to refine it. 

I’d be happy to discuss this with you in more detail — please don’t hesitate to contact me.

Dan Hey
Practice Manager I have always been very happy with the care provided to be by the drs there.

From seeing the, now retired, Dr Patel, who was a wonderful dr. He was always thorough and took time to listen to my concerns, needs, etc.

Now, they have 3 very good Dr's at the practice, Dr Saron, Dr Hannan and Dr Vaidya. All are warm, welcoming, thorough, knowledgeable, and caring.

The nurses there have always been excellent, too. And a new nurse/dr works with them now and she's is all of the above, too.

In addition, I always get an appointment on the same day, via their emergency service system.

You can't get through quickly on the phones, ever, but they do have most of there services online now, which is easy enough to use, if you are able. It may not be great for those of an age who may not be able to use the online service.

My only gripe is that the reception staff can make you wait when at the counter and there's a lack of caring/concern, and smiles, too.
Most of the reception staff are very helpful, but there can still be that edge there where you think they're doing you a favour by being there and speaking to you. That is the pit fall. I feel receptionists (and I have been one) should be friendly, warm, polite and considerate, especially at a Dr's surgery. And perhaps, just say with a smile, 'I will be with you shortly.' You know, like you would get at a dentist's surgery.

Overall, though, I am very satisfied with the service I have received over the 25 years and I would like to thank the Park Medical Centre for providing me with such good care and service for all those years.",null,[0,137]]]],[null,1742915122000000,1742915122000000,"11 months ago",null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA"],"https://business.google.com/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/deletereply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA"],null,"https://business.google.com/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA",[null,null,null,"/local/business/5646143656212192121/customers/reviews/reply?p=CiNDaFpEU1VoTk1HOW5TMFZKUTBGblRVTjNhSFJxUmtkbkVBRRAA"],null,["en"],[["Dear Melanie,
Thank you for sharing your experience with the Park Medical Centre. We truly appreciate your loyalty and kind words over the past 25 years. It is heartwarming to know that our doctors, nurses, and healthcare team have provided you with excellent care and support, and we're so pleased you feel valued by the practice.
We're thrilled that our current team of doctors—Dr Sarin, Dr Hannan, and Dr Vaidya—and our nursing staff have earned your trust and appreciation. Hearing that you find them warm, knowledgeable, and caring truly reinforces the ethos we aim to uphold.

Your feedback on our appointment system is also greatly appreciated. We implemented the online appointment system to help reduce phone queues, and we're glad it has been a useful option for many of our patients. This was also done to improve access for all patients, whether they can use the internet or not as the phone queues have significantly reduced since the start of 2024. However, we have also noticed that the phone queues have unfortunately started to increase again over the last few months, and we believe this is due to us accepting more patient requests until a lot later in the day causing more incoming phone calls. Your observation is noted, and we will review how we can optimize both systems to better serve our patients.

Regarding reception, we are grateful for your honest observations. We understand that a welcoming and friendly reception experience is crucial in a healthcare environment, and we will ensure your constructive feedback is shared with the team. Your suggestion about smiles and prompt communication, such as saying “I will be with you shortly,” is both thoughtful and practical, and we believe it can make a meaningful difference in enhancing the overall patient experience. We appreciate your input, which will help us improve the service we provide at the front desk.

Your thoughtful recognition and constructive feedback motivate us to continue improving. Thank you for your kind words and for trusting us with your care for so many years. We are honored to have been your healthcare provider and look forward to continuing to serve you in the future.

Kind regards,
Dan Hey
Practice Manager",null,[0,172]]]],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3aHRqRkdnEAE!2m1!1s0x0:0x3e6f754e0ac01c03!3m1!1s2@1:CIHM0ogKEICAgMCwhtjFGg%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3aHRqRkdnEAE&t=1&entityid=ChZDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3aHRqRkdnEi0KF0NJSE0wb2dLRUlDQWdNQ3dodGpGbWdFEhJDZ3NJcmJ2bHZnWVF3T2k5WkEaLAoWQ0lITTBvZ0tFSUNBZ01Dd2h0akZXZxISQ2dzSXJidmx2Z1lRd09pOVpBIhIJAAAAAAAAAAARAxzACk51bz4qEkNnc0lyYnZsdmdZUXdPaTlaQQ&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwi59baCiayTAxWnJHsEHQgZFpkQoykIEygB"],null,[null,[[1,0]]]],"0ahUKEwi59baCiayTAxWnJHsEHQgZFpkQ0pMFCBEoBQ"],null,"CAESZENBRVEyQUVhUkVOcVJVbEJVa2x3UTJkdlFWQTNNa2R3Vnpab1RteGZYMFZvUWxreGNHTlFWblpyVWxCMWVuWXhiRVZCUVVGQlFVZG5iamt5YjJORFlXeGljVVV5VlZsQlEwbEI="],[["ChdDSUhNMG9nS0VJQ0FnTUN3MnJyRjdRRRAB",["0x0:0x3e6f754e0ac01c03",null,1742285520754116,1742285520754116,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114407604524547275611/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["Damon Alexander Cole","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a/ACg8ocJk8dl_jEUItE1OegMyjzU9SsPa2LICgduzfeCFDvQHw9flc5M=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/114407604524547275611?hl=en"],"114407604524547275611",null,7,1,null,[0,3,1],0,["7 reviews",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwi59baCiayTAxWnJHsEHQgZFpkQ7LoGCBUoAA"]]]],null,"a year ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[5],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Massive thank you to Dr Vaidya, all the team are amazing at Park Medical Centre, really friendly, helpful and professional so I don't want to take anything away from the whole team there but Dr Vaidya being my main point of contact for my health and wellbeing has been incredible.
